description: This file sets up a live WebRTC call using LiveKit, integrating speech recognition, language model processing, and text-to-speech to facilitate a conversational AI system. It defines event handlers for participant join and data reception, constructs a processing pipeline, and manages asynchronous execution.

classes.name: LiveKitTransport
classes.description: Handles WebRTC transport using LiveKit, including event handling for participant join and data reception.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for the conversational system.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters for execution.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for TTS speech output.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that configures the system, sets up event handlers, and runs the pipeline.

methods.name: on_first_participant_joined
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the first participant joins, plays a greeting message.

methods.name: on_data_received
methods.description: Event handler for incoming participant data, processes transcription and manages conversation flow.
